title: Love it
body: Very good app. Useful in tracking daily repeating tasks. I love the month view grid, as so much information is conveyed in such little space. Only small change I would like to see is ability to set my own colours for the grid. But overall I absolutely love the app, and already am living a more balanced life since using it. So extremely practical app. Thanks to the author.

title: Amazing tool
body: I’ve tried Streaks before but didn’t enjoy its circle based interface. Wanted an interface with scroll and that looked easy to read. This one has been amazing. The integration with Apple Health is superb (for habits like walking , meditation, etc) and the countdown timers and all is perfect!! And the stats are so comprehensive and a treat to track

title: Dayrise is better at this price range
body:
No analytics, Habit widget does not have title so good luck with multiple widgets, No Apple health connectivity, only gamified 3D animations at ₹499/yr
You can get far more features with Dayrise at that price point
